tools.name: homeassistant_list_entities
tools.description: List Home Assistant entities with their current state. Optionally filter by domain (e.g. light, switch, climate, cover, lock, fan, media_player, sensor, binary_sensor).

domain.description: Entity domain to filter by (optional). Examples: light, switch, climate, cover, lock

tools.name: homeassistant_get_state
tools.description: Get the full state and attributes of a single Home Assistant entity.

tools.name: homeassistant_call_service
tools.description: Call a Home Assistant service to control a device. Use this to turn devices on/off, toggle them, set temperature, lock/unlock, open/close covers, and more. IMPORTANT: When the user asks to control a SPECIFIC device by name, you MUST pass its entity_id. Only use area_id when the user asks about ALL devices in a room.

domain.description: Service domain, e.g. light, switch, climate, cover, lock, fan

service.description: Service name, e.g. turn_on, turn_off, toggle, set_temperature, lock, unlock, open_cover, close_cover

entity_id.description: Target a specific device by its entity ID (e.g. light.orb). Required when controlling a single named device — look it up first with homeassistant_list_entities. Only omit when targeting an entire area.

area_id.description: Target ALL devices of this domain in a room (e.g. 'living_room'). WARNING: this affects every matching device in the room, not a single device. Use the area_id shown by homeassistant_list_entities. Do NOT use when the user names a specific device.

service_data.description: Additional service parameters, e.g. {"temperature": 21} for climate or {"brightness_pct": 80} for lights
